entries.description: Account-based marketing flips the traditional funnel.
Answer Engine Optimization is the practice of structuring content so AI answer systems can find, trust, and cite it.
Agentic marketing describes marketing operations where AI agents hold decision authority over defined processes.
An AI agent is software that pursues a goal by taking a sequence of actions on its own.
AI content generation uses large language models to produce marketing copy.
AI search visibility measures how often and how prominently a brand, product, or content appears in AI-generated answers.
A customer data platform collects and unifies customer data from every touchpoint.
A chatbot is software that conducts text or voice conversations with users, typically on a website, messaging app, or social platform.
A CRM is the system of record for every interaction your company has with a prospect or customer.
Conversion rate optimization is the practice of increasing the percentage of visitors who take a desired action, buying, signing up, requesting a demo.
A customer journey map is a visual representation of every step a customer takes from first awareness to purchase and beyond.
Dynamic creative optimization assembles ad creatives in real time from modular components.
Deliverability is the measure of whether your emails actually reach the inbox instead of the spam folder.
A data management platform collects and organizes audience data, mostly anonymous, cookie-based identifiers, for use in programmatic advertising.
A demand-side platform is the buying interface for programmatic advertising.
An email sequence is a series of automated emails sent on a schedule or triggered by behavior.
First-party data is information you collect directly from your customers and prospects.
Generative engine optimization is the practice of getting a brand cited and correctly described inside AI-generated answers.
Lead scoring assigns a numerical value to each prospect based on their likelihood to buy.
An attribution model is the rule that decides which marketing touchpoint gets credit for a conversion. First-touch credits the first interaction.
Marketing automation is software that runs repetitive marketing tasks without manual intervention.
Marketing operations is the function that manages the technology, processes, and data behind marketing execution.
The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources.
An MQL is a lead that marketing deems ready for sales based on engagement signals.
Website personalization changes what a visitor sees based on who they are or what they've done before.
Programmatic advertising is the automated buying and selling of ad inventory through real-time bidding.
SEO is the practice of improving a website's visibility in organic (non-paid) search results.
Social listening is the practice of monitoring social media channels, forums, review sites, and news outlets.
UTM parameters are tags appended to URLs to track where traffic comes from.
